name: Lust Chronicle
source:
You play as a human who got in accident during the travel to The capital of Willberg which end up at Greenwich Valley, You will become the adventurer and setting off across Willberg to face threats, uncover secrets, and forge your own path.
As an adventurer, you can accept any kind of quest — gathering herbs, helping villagers, assisting guilds — all in pursuit of glory.
